items.title: Red Cross volunteers die from suspected Ebola in DR Congo
items.description: They are thought to have caught the virus before the outbreak was identified, the Red Cross says.

items.title: Trump says Iran deal 'largely negotiated' including reopening Strait of Hormuz
items.description: Tehran also signals progress on talks but says the key issue of nuclear weapons is not part of an initial framework it is working on.

items.title: BBC at the site of China's worst mining disaster in more than a decade
items.description: At least 82 people have been killed after a gas explosion at the Liushenyu mine in China.

items.title: At least 82 killed in Chinese coal mine explosion
items.description: The blast in Shanxi province constitutes the country's worst mining disaster in 16 years.

items.title: Kane's hat trick seals Bayern Munich's 21st German Cup win
items.description: Harry Kane scored three times to fire Bayern Munich to a 3-0 victory over Stuttgart in the German Cup final. The win delivered a domestic double for the Bavarian giants and ended a six-year trophy drought.

items.title: UK records hottest day of year as forecasters warn of more extreme heat
items.description: <p>Temperature reaches 30.5C in Kent as amber health alerts issued before bank holiday temperatures rise</p><p>The UK has recorded its hottest day of the year so far, with temperatures reaching 30.5C in Kent as forecasters warned more extreme heat could follow over the bank holiday weekend.</p><p>The temperature in Frittenden also marked the first time since 2012 the UK has reached 30C in May, according to the Met Office.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardia

items.title: Cyprus election expected to shake up national politics
items.description: Cyprus goes to the polls to elect a new parliament on Sunday. The vote is expected to reshape the country's political landscape, weaken traditional parties and accelerate the rise of new anti-establishment movements.
